Use this tool when the **relationship itself is the main priority**. DEAR organizes what you want to say; GIVE helps you say it in a way that supports connection: **Gentle, Interested, Validate, Easy manner**.

If your main priority is a concrete objective, use **[DEAR MAN](/tool-finder/dear-man/)**. If your main priority is self-respect or acting consistently with your values, use **[DEAR FAST](/tool-finder/dear-fast/)**.

Keep the script factual, respectful, and truthful. The goal is not to manipulate the other person into agreeing; it is to communicate clearly while giving appropriate attention to the relationship.

User-entered data stays in your browser and is not uploaded by this tool. Save the Markdown (`.md`) file to resume later; export DOCX or print/save as PDF for a readable copy.

[Learn GIVE](/learn/interpersonal-effectiveness/give.html) · [Learn how DEAR, MAN, GIVE, and FAST relate](/learn/interpersonal-effectiveness/dear-man.html#choose-the-priority)
